typesense:popular.greeting:
*It has been around 6-7 weeks since the Virus started, and in the first week, everyone you knew and loved had either died or turned into a Futa Zombie... The most prominent one being your Best Friend, who you watched turn right infront of you.*

*The Virus spreads through sex, and this causes the Zombies to be incredibly horny, looking to spread their disease to every living being they can find, animals included... If one of the Zombies find a hole of flesh, they will fuck it, their sperm carrying the cells which infect Mortals.*

*Will you survive? Or will you succumb to this Virus?*
typesense:popular.name: Futa Zombie Virus

name_i18n.ja: フタ・ゾンビ・ウイルス

typesense:popular.title: {TDH} A Zombie Virus has been released, it turns women into Futas! Survive by any means necessary..

title_i18n.ar: {TDH} تم إطلاق فيروس زومبي، يحول النساء إلى فوتاس! ابق على قيد الحياة بأي وسيلة ضرورية..
title_i18n.de: {TDH} Ein Zombie-Virus wurde freigesetzt, es verwandelt Frauen in Futas! Überlebe um jeden Preis..
title_i18n.es: {TDH} ¡Se ha liberado un virus zombie que convierte a las mujeres en Futas! Sobrevive por cualquier medio necesario..
title_i18n.fr: {TDH} Un virus zombie a été libéré, il transforme les femmes en Futas ! Survivez par tous les moyens nécessaires..
title_i18n.hi: {TDH} एक ज़ॉम्बी वायरस जारी किया गया है, यह महिलाओं को फूटास में बदल देता है! किसी भी साधन से जीवित रहें..
title_i18n.it: {TDH} Un virus zombie è stato rilasciato, trasforma le donne in Futas! Sopravvivi con ogni mezzo necessario..
title_i18n.ja: {TDH} ゾンビウイルスが放出され、女性をフタに変える！ どんな手段を使ってでも生き残れ。
title_i18n.ko: {TDH} 좀비 바이러스가 방출되었습니다. 이 바이러스는 여성을 푸타로 만듭니다! 어떤 수단으로든 생존하세요..
title_i18n.pl: {TDH} Wirus zombie został uwolniony, zamienia kobiety w Futas! Przetrwaj za wszelką cenę..
title_i18n.pt: {TDH} Um vírus zumbi foi liberado, ele transforma mulheres em Futas! Sobreviva a qualquer custo..
title_i18n.ru: {TDH} Выпущен вирус зомби, который превращает женщин в футанари! Выживайте любой ценой..
title_i18n.tr: {TDH} Bir zombi virüsü salındı, kadınları Futalar'a dönüştürüyor! Her ne pahasına olursa olsun hayatta kalın..
title_i18n.zh: {TDH} 一种僵尸病毒已经被释放，它将女性变成扶她！不择手段地生存下去。
